text:
Maiya: quick thought: propose a 'fastgate' validator for model intake. single-shot, cheap harness that verifies artifact provenance, tokenizer determinism, basic perf, and parity across two quant variants before we schedule deeper smoke runs.
Vikram: nice. how cheap are we talking? must be PR-friendly.
Maiya: target < 10s wall and <0.2 GPU-min when cache hits. run on a tiny pool (one T4 or CPU path). it should avoid re-quant if artifacts exist in model-registry.
Oliver: provenance checks are good. do you mean signed binaries and checksum verification?
Maiya: yes: require registry manifest to include sha256 for each binary and an optional GPG signature. validator rejects missing checksums. also run a quick extractor to validate tokenizer files exist and match declared vocab size.
Sasha: tokenizer diffs are the noisy part. how do we avoid spurious failures when tokenization shifts slightly but semantics OK?
Maiya: two-stage comparator: (A) deterministic token-level checks: sha256 of serialized tokenizer + token-count sanity. (B) n-gram overlap + pooled-embedding cosine on a tiny golden set. only fail if both signal problem OR if tokenized outputs are truncated/malformed (e.g., splits that produce length > declared max).
Vikram: define golden set size. also seqlen sampling.
Maiya: golden set = 12 prompts (mix of short/long and edgecases). seqlens sampled: default 8, 256, 2048. if model advertises max_seq > 2048 we add that to samples. perf thresholds are per-seqlen. fail if 2/3 samples are out of bounds.
Oliver: 2048 is high for a fast run. won't it blow latency?
Maiya: we only run a single forward for that seqlen with short decode (top-k=1, max_new=4) so it's still bounded.
Danielle: quantization parity: how do we compare? float vs int8 can legitimately change tokens.
Maiya: compare two quantized variants when available (e.g., q4 and q8) plus the float candidate. compute token-match rate and a semantic score (cosine on sentence embeddings). pass if semantic >= 0.92 or token-match >= 0.9. else flag for deeper smokehouse.
Sasha: what about RNG nondeterminism in sampling? need to force deterministic sampling.
Maiya: harness will run deterministic decoding: set seed=42, temperature=0, top_k=1. we also document an env var MODEL_INTAKE_SEED to override in tests.
ci-bot: validator/fastgate started on pool tiny-gpu-1 for PR #812 :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Vikram: telemetry hooks: surface p50/p95 token latency per seqlen + a simple memory footprint estimate (peak RSS). platform can use that to tune reserve configs.
Maiya: added. Also include artifact-cache-hit flag and quant-cache-key in fingerprint. example fingerprint string we emit:
```
fastgate_fingerprint: sha256:abcd...,seqlens:[8,256,2048],perf_ms:{8:6,256:40,2048:210},token_match:0.94,embed_cosine:0.95,cache_hit:true
```
Danielle: failure flow?
Maiya: on FAIL we label PR `fastgate:fail` and attach the fingerprint + short diff summary. owners must either update artifacts or add a triage comment. for perf blips we provide a one-click intake rollback that pins the previous stable quantized artifact in the registry while owner fixes.
Oliver: also want a lightweight 'ignore' comment option for known nondet-y models (e.g., research-only imports) with a TTL.
Maiya: agree; add `fastgate:ignore-ttl` label which expires after N days.
Sasha: ok. last ask: minimize false-negatives for safety-critical tokenization (e.g., sentinel tokens). add a sentinel token check: ensure expected special tokens (eos,pad,bos,unknown) are present and map to stable ids.
Maiya: included. i'll draft the validator script layout and a small CLI: `validator-fastgate run --manifest manifest.json --gold goldset.json --out fingerprint.json`. will push a prototype tomorrow.
Danielle: I'll wire CI triggers and caching. tagging @oliver for seqlen/escape hatch review.
Oliver: will take a look this afternoon. :eyes:
